name: BMW Engine and TCU Map Editor and Flasher

mentions.name: BMW Engine and TCU Map Editor and Flasher
mentions.description: This tool edits and flashes BMW engine maps (N13, N20, N55, S55, B58, S58) and transmission control unit (TCU) maps (ZF8HP45 and ZF8HP50) for vehicle tuning.
